verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Ramp lets users spin up a new virtual/business expense card in under a minute for a specific purchase, supporting instant, purpose-scoped card creation. However, there's no direct first-party documentation explicitly describing vendor- or category-locked virtual card controls (e.g., merchant-lock, spend-category restrictions) beyond general references to approvals and multi-entity restrictions. Missing for 10: explicit docs on merchant/category-locking rules for virtual cards, admin UI screenshots/workflow for scoping a card to a single vendor or ad-spend category, and independent verification of that specific control granularity.
